column3: The Hebrew locates fleeing in the cave; BSB says into the cave.
The Hebrew names completing for him without explicitly naming His purpose; BSB supplies His purpose.
The Hebrew first says He sends from heaven and has a singular oppressor; BSB says reaches down and has plural tramplers.
The Hebrew describes burning ones without separately naming beasts, and has a singular spear, tongue, and sword; BSB supplies beasts and uses plurals.
The Hebrew places glory over the earth without a separate verb cover; BSB supplies cover.
The Hebrew names the instruments in the order lyre and harp; BSB says harp and lyre.
